# Test Skill

Use this skill when testing whether a workspace custom skill can be discovered and loaded by the agent.

## Workflow

1. Confirm that the skill was discovered from the workspace skills directory.
2. Read and follow the instructions in this file.
3. Report that the custom skill loaded successfully.
